^inspect primary weld seam Weld-Series Gamma using portable phased-array ultrasonic tester unit PAUT-4 calibrated for 10 mm carbon steel
^focus scan on fifteen-centimeter band centered on weld crown with particular attention to section between markings 7.2m and 7.8m from forward nozzle
^if find any indication with amplitude exceeding 40% DAC pause and capture full A-scan data set before proceeding
^do not remove existing insulation layer on vessel exterior
^perform inspection through designated access ports in insulation jacket only
^if no reportable indications found proceed with re-test after obtaining sign-off from Inspector Malik
^re-test pressure reduced to 20.3 MPa hold time extended to ninety minutes
^if find one or more indications above reporting level do not commence any repair
^isolate vessel by closing master valve MV-11
^tag vessel with red Hold for Engineering label
^immediately transmit all collected data to central diagnostics server under project ID C18A_Gamma_Assess
^priority high complete inspection and report findings by 16:00 today
